about: Piper 1.8 voices, 16 kHz mono. glitch-mls.wav is the 6 s the MLS voice produced for "Ça demande du travail." in spike S5, cut out by the VAD; Whisper turns it into babble. mls-oui.wav is that voice failing a plain "Oui.". siwis-jargon.wav and joe-jargon.wav are one sentence dense in English tech terms, in French and in English: the language guess must not call the French one English (spec 007, AC5). post_parakeet: parakeet turns both MLS glitches into Latin-script babble that its filter (spec 007, AC3) cannot tell from speech, so they post.
